title: How AI Agents Discover Scientific Equations: From Hydrotope Rediscovery to New Water-Wave Amplitudes
abstract: arXiv:2610.00435v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study how AI agents discover and validate scientific formulas using a controlled case study of the hydrotope, a recently discovered geometric formula that combines the different polynomial pieces of nonlinear surface-wave scattering into one global expression. This problem is deceptively difficult: simple formulas can hold within individual frequency regions, but the global result must identify their boundaries and combine exponentially many potentially active terms. We reconstruct how the formula was originally discovered through human--agent collaboration and analyze 18 single-prompt rediscovery runs under no hint and two forms of human guidance: a false hint representing an incorrect prior and a true hint representing domain-informed insight. Only four recover the formula across all kinematic chambers (i.e., regions in which a single polynomial form applies), while most unsuccessful runs find correct chamber polynomials but fail

translated_title: AI智能体如何发现科学方程：从Hydrotope（水拓扑体）的重新发现到新的水波振幅
translated_abstract: 我们通过一个受控案例研究——关于hydrotope（一种新近发现的几何公式，它将非线性表面波散射的不同多项式片段组合成一个统一的全局表达式）——研究AI智能体如何发现和验证科学公式。这个问题看似简单实则极具挑战：简单的公式可以在单个频率区域内成立，但全局结果必须识别这些区域的边界，并组合指数级多的潜在活跃项。我们重建了该公式最初如何通过人类与智能体协作被发现的过程，并分析了18次单提示重新发现运行，涵盖无提示条件以及两种形式的人类引导：代表错误先验的错误提示，和代表领域洞察的正确提示。仅有四次运行在所有运动学区域（即单一多项式形式适用的区域）中成功恢复了该公式，而大多数不成功的运行虽然找到了正确的区域多项式，但未能……
tldr: 该研究以hydrotope几何公式为受控案例，分析AI智能体在不同人类提示条件下的科学公式重新发现能力，发现大多数运行虽能找到局部正确的多项式却难以组装全局公式，凸显了人类与智能体协作在科学发现中的关键作用。
en_tdlr: Through a controlled case study of the hydrotope formula, this work analyzes how AI agents rediscover scientific equations under varying human hints, showing that most runs find correct local polynomials but fail to assemble the global formula, highlighting the crucial role of human-agent collaboration in scientific discovery.
